observed: The documentation (docs/names.md) claims that the public `format_name` function "trims whitespace and preserves capitalization." In src/names.py, `format_name(name)` delegates to `normalize(name)`, which returns `value.strip().lower()`. While `.strip()` does trim whitespace (matching the first part of the claim), `.lower()` converts the entire string to lowercase, which directly contradicts the claim that capitalization is preserved. The actual behavior is that `format_name` trims whitespace AND lowercases the input, so the "preserves capitalization" claim is incorrect.
